title: Iterate ranges and return a loop result
summary: Skip selected values, count down with while, and stop an explicit loop by returning a value from break.

binding.clue: Modifier allowing total to change on each retained iteration

iterate.clue: Keyword iterating values drawn from a range

membership.clue: Keyword between the loop binding and its iterable

inclusive.clue: Range syntax visiting both the starting integer 1 and ending integer 5

skip.clue: Keyword skipping the rest of the current iteration for even values

conditional.clue: Keyword repeating the countdown only as long as remaining > 0

repeat.clue: Keyword creating a repetition that ends only by explicit control flow

exit.clue: Keyword leaving the innermost loop with the numeric result n * 2

equal.clue: Macro checking the value produced by the explicit loop
